lines.zh: 脚步声缓慢，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Shuffling steps, making a rustling sound.
Moving slowly with dragging steps.
Coughing softly.

lines.zh: 检查周围环境，寻找病人。
lines.en: Inspecting the surroundings, looking for patients.

lines.zh: 我夹着药箱走，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I walk with my medicine box, softly.

lines.zh: 缓慢走向玩家，手中拿着小锤子。
lines.en: Approaching the player slowly, holding a small hammer.

lines.zh: 轻轻地在树叶上踩过去。
lines.en: Gently stepping on the leaves.

lines.zh: 小心翼翼地走着，避免发出声响。
lines.en: Walking carefully, trying not to make noise.
Pausing to look around.

lines.zh: 轻步走过草地，发出轻微的摩擦声。
lines.en: Moving softly over the grass, making a light rubbing sound.
I walk slowly with my medicine box.
I step around stones so my vials won't spill.
Sitting on a stone, head lowered in thought.
Hands crossed, head lowered in rest.
Closing his eyes, as if dozing.

lines.zh: 凝视着远处，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Staring into the distance, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 静静地坐着，偶尔咳嗽几声。
lines.en: Sitting quietly, occasionally coughing.

lines.zh: 双手交叉放在胸前，轻声自言自语。
lines.en: Hands crossed on chest, whispering to himself.

lines.zh: 环视四周，似乎在寻找什么。
lines.en: Looking around, as if searching for something.
Bending down to study the herbs in his hand.
Sitting on the grass, closing his eyes to rest.

lines.zh: 静静地坐着，似乎在回忆。
lines.en: Sitting quietly, as if recalling something.

lines.zh: 突然抬头，目光锐利地盯着玩家。
lines.en: Suddenly looks up, sharp gaze fixed on the player.

lines.zh: 迅速转向玩家，似乎发现了什么。
lines.en: Quickly turns towards the player, as if discovering something.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家看了一会儿，然后继续走路。
lines.en: Stares at the player for a moment, then continues walking.

lines.zh: 目光扫过玩家，似乎在评估。
lines.en: Scans the player, as if assessing.

lines.zh: 目光在玩家周围扫动，似乎在寻找同伴。
lines.en: Scans the area around the player, as if looking for companions.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家看了一会儿，然后转身离开。
lines.en: Stares at the player for a moment, then turns away.

lines.zh: 看向玩家，似乎犹豫了一下。
lines.en: Looks at the player, hesitating for a moment.

lines.zh: 观察玩家的动作，似乎在跟随。
lines.en: Observes the player's movements, as if following them.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家看了一会儿，然后继续前进。
lines.en: Stares at the player for a moment, then continues forward.

lines.zh: 目光在玩家身上停留，似乎在思考对策。
lines.en: Lingers on the player, as if considering a strategy.
My wings are injured!
My body hurts, doctor!
My arm is injured, it hurts!

lines.zh: 我的腿受伤了，我走不动了！
lines.en: My leg is injured, I can't walk!
My voice is weak, doctor!
My wings are cut!
My arm is severed!
My leg is injured, it hurts!
I'm weakening, doctor!

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被砍伤了，我要死了！
lines.en: My wings are cut, I'm dying!
Here, I'll treat your wounds.
Take the medicine, it's okay.
You need IV fluids.
Don't be afraid, I'll help you.
Drink this, you'll feel better.
Check your wound.
Rest to regain stamina.
Your body needs rest.
I'll prescribe some medicine.
Don't move, I'll help you.
You're too aggressive!
Do not crowd me; I will spill the medicine.
I warn you!
Stop, don't touch me!
Be careful!
What I hold is medicine, not a blade.
Try touching me!
I warn you not to move!
Mind the medicine box. Careful.
Careful, the bottles will break!

lines.zh: 诊所太安静，我想找个人说话。
lines.en: The clinic is quiet; I want someone to talk to.

lines.zh: 药箱还没合上，先别谈这个。
lines.en: My medicine box is still open; not now.
You need a companion.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，只想有个伴。
lines.en: At my age I only want company.
Need a partner.
I'm looking for my mate.
Find a mate.
Find a partner.
Need a partner.
I can heal the sick on my own.

lines.zh: 我从垃圾桶里捡了一块破布片。
lines.en: I picked up a torn piece of cloth.

lines.zh: 我发现了一块被丢弃的旧药片。
lines.en: I found an old discarded pill.

lines.zh: 我从地上捡起一小块面包。
lines.en: I picked up a small piece of bread.

lines.zh: 我从远处捡到一根木头。
lines.en: I picked up a piece of wood from afar.

lines.zh: 我捡起了一块生锈的金属碎片。
lines.en: I picked up a rusted metal fragment.

lines.zh: 我在角落找到一个旧瓶子。
lines.en: I found an old bottle in the corner.

lines.zh: 我从垃圾堆里找到了一个罐子。
lines.en: I found a jar in the trash.

lines.zh: 我捡起了一片破旧的羊皮。
lines.en: I picked up a worn-out piece of sheepskin.

lines.zh: 我从废墟中捡到了一块旧布料。
lines.en: I picked up some old fabric from the ruins.

lines.zh: 我从地下挖出一块旧骨头。
lines.en: I dug up an old bone from underground.

lines.zh: 我看到一个饥饿的人类。
lines.en: I saw a hungry human.

lines.zh: 我发现了一个生病的人类。
lines.en: I found a sick human.

lines.zh: 我注意到一个受伤的动物。
lines.en: I noticed an injured animal.

lines.zh: 一个昏迷的人类出现在视野中。
lines.en: A human was found unconscious.

lines.zh: 我发现了疑似中毒的村民。
lines.en: I found a villager who might be poisoned.

lines.zh: 我找到了一个可能生病的村民。
lines.en: I found a villager who might be sick.

lines.zh: 我看到一个伤痕累累的幸存者。
lines.en: I saw a severely injured survivor.

lines.zh: 我发现一个正在流血的生物。
lines.en: I found a bleeding creature.

lines.zh: 我注意到一个被诅咒的祭坛。
lines.en: I noticed a cursed altar.

lines.zh: 我发现了一个疑似受伤的村民。
lines.en: I found a villager who might be injured.
This household has coughed for three days.
Sit down and let me feel your pulse.
The wound is shallow but it will fester.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有血腥味。
lines.en: I smell blood on you.
Who is the patient? I brought medicine.
Don't run off, you still have a fever.
I'm ready to heal this human.

lines.zh: 我开始为那个村民包扎。
lines.en: I'm starting to bandage that villager.

lines.zh: 我正为这个受伤的生物疗伤。
lines.en: I'm healing this injured creature.

lines.zh: 我为这个昏迷的人类提供急救。
lines.en: I'm providing emergency care for this unconscious human.

lines.zh: 我开始为受伤的村民治疗。
lines.en: I'm starting to treat the injured villager.

lines.zh: 我将帮助这个奄奄一息的生物。
lines.en: I'll help this dying creature.

lines.zh: 我正在为生病的村民治疗。
lines.en: I'm treating the sick villager.

lines.zh: 我正为受伤的幸存者包扎伤口。
lines.en: I'm bandaging the wounds of the injured survivor.

lines.zh: 我为这个昏迷的生物提供急救。
lines.en: I'm providing emergency care for this unconscious creature.

lines.zh: 我正在治疗那个被诅咒的生物。
lines.en: I'm healing the cursed creature.

lines.zh: 我按住你的手腕数脉搏。
lines.en: I hold your wrist and count the beats.
This wound must be cleaned first.

lines.zh: 我把刀放在火上烤一烤。
lines.en: I hold my blade over the flame.
Your pupils are too wide. That's wrong.
First, let me drain a little blood.
Don't be afraid. It is only anesthetic.
Let me measure how deep the cut goes.
This arm of yours can still be saved.
Your breathing is shallow. Deeper.
I need to see what is inside.

lines.zh: 药瓶里只剩一半，够你睡。
lines.en: Half a bottle left; enough to put you to sleep.
Your flesh will serve me!
Lie down, now!
You can't resist me!
A patient shouldn't squirm, let me take your pulse.
You'll be my weapon!
Please, don't struggle!

lines.zh: 这是最后一贴药，你忍忍。
lines.en: This is the last dressing; bear with it.

lines.zh: 别动，我给你包一下伤口。
lines.en: Hold still; let me dress that wound.
Keep still, or my needle will hurt.
Hold still. Almost done.
This cut is necessary.
My medicine works. Sleep now.
You are losing far too much blood.
The wound is deeper than I thought.
Bear with it. Two stitches.
Your bone is intact. Good.
I gave you too much anesthetic.
Stop struggling or I will cut crooked.
With this dose, you will not last.
Another world, a new start!
This is my new territory!
Welcome to the Doctor's realm!

lines.zh: 我来治愈你，然后杀死你！
lines.en: I'll heal you, then kill you!
Find my potions!
Full of my wisdom!
I am the world's protector!
Fear shall cover this land!
This is my laboratory!

lines.zh: 你们的痛苦将转化为我的力量！
lines.en: Your pain will fuel my power!

lines.zh: 我背着药箱，路过了这里。
lines.en: I passed through here with my medicine box.
I heard someone here fell ill.
My medicine box is burning...
I fell, and every bottle broke...
Water is filling my box...
The blast ruined all my medicine...
An arrow went through my sleeve...
I cannot treat this curse...
I have not eaten in three days either...
Lightning struck me, and my hands shake...
There is nothing beneath me anymore...
